title: Seetelhotels.de
description: Seetel Hotels (SEETEL Hotel GmbH & Co. Betriebs KG) has been notified that a substantial volume of confidential and internal corporate data has been compromised.  The affected data includes, but is not limited to:  Full guest identity records, government-issued passport and ID numbers, payment card details (credit card numbers, CVVs, and expiration dates), direct booking notes, special requests, dietary restrictions, documented allergies, and medical/health-related accommodation preferences. Invoices, payment transaction logs, accounts receivable and payable (Debitorenbuchhaltung / Kreditorenbuchhaltung) records, internal financial audits, and controlling documentation.
